semantic_checks.independent_check: Independently read the original cached HTML control-arm paragraph: equal numbers are sampled randomly from high, middle and low probabilities produced by MAP1, then labelled by privacy officers. The original mixed-set and positive Parallel Set passages support the retained sampling and evaluation limits.

Independently parsed the four original arXiv HTML element IDs. They establish the honest server, exact aggregate, candidate-update game and simulation-based population sampling for mean/covariance estimates; a separate original paragraph confirms the Gaussian approximation.

Independently extracted original PDF methods pages 14 and 18–19 and Table 10/page 42. These define node clustering and global-model generation and list separate omissions of OPTICS-CR, FAWO HMAC-SHA and RSA-ECDSA; removal is an ablation comparison.

Independently extracted original PDF pages 7–8 and 10–11. The recursive hierarchy, dataset B addition, real/(real+fake) explanation precision and approximate 93% to 66% depth-one change agree with the resolution.

Independently extracted original PDF pages 5–8. Explicit access features, contextual relational latent features and prior-violation counts/fractions support the Feats, Rel and History definitions; model labels and uncertainty scope are retained.

Parsed original XML paragraphs and Table 2. The source reports 90,385 distinct identifiers/Unique IDs and associated anomaly/normal counts but the relevant dataset passages and table do not assign that identifier count to users, patients, accesses or sessions. Leaving the entity unit unspecified is justified.

Read installed sharing/reconstruction code and strict project wrapper. Shares separately protect rd_seed and sk1; active seeds or dropped-client keys are reconstructed upstream, while the project rejects an incomplete cohort. Threshold does not license a two-client training continuation.

Read constructed seed generation, repeated-word XOR reduction, old-output equality and candidate-output distinctness assertions, and retained result booleans. Agreement denotes the deliberately different required results, not matching old/new arrays or general collision resistance.

Read the actual executed branch and retained JSON: only check_stage(SHARE_KEYS, SETUP) was called; exception=null, callbacks=0, advancements=0. Independently read the handler and _setup reset code. The reset is implementation-defined and was not executed by this direct fixture.

Read freshness() set construction and retained SV-06 result. Exact byte values are compared within separate categories, with serialized masked replies represented by ordered tuples. Only counts/booleans were retained; no secret bytes or digests were read or exported by QC.

Read both original public-fixture implementations. enumerate(values) indexes client vectors; the float32 offset is multiplied by i+1, then the actual resulting float32 vectors are cast to float64 by the weighted oracle.

Read record_bytes(), measurement_scope(), timing and reporting boundaries, capsule selection/redaction, and public harness patches. The real measurement_scope reads/validates fixed_config through resources; patched calls bypass that read/validation while observers/counters/capsule and selected-output scans still execute. No universal redaction or network claim follows.

Read exact rd_seed, pairwise-key, stored share-encryption-key and serialized-reply set insertions plus endpoint equality checks. Each unordered pair contributes once. Retained SV-06 counts are 20 sessions/60 client contexts with category cardinalities as prescribed; no entropy or privacy proof is claimed.

Read the supplied action schema, full-benchmark dictionary, release dictionary and generation notes. The schema lists literal C/E/R/U plus unknown/missing categories; the full dictionary names audit action codes; the release dictionary explicitly says individual meanings require generator documentation. Source-authenticated per-code meanings remain unavailable.

Read fullsize B/C configurations/policy and original archived result metadata. They retain 119 input features, 86,487 parameters and complete routine memberships, with five-round B/C engineering cells and one central engineering epoch. All four B/C cells report PASS and test_data_opened=false; this is not a full main-study budget or privacy certification.

Read the database+source+ID and source+ID union code, and recomputed record identities from stored public bibliographic JSON. 488 database records reduce to 281 exact source/ID pairs; retained sources are MED and ETH, including ETH:771510. This is not DOI or study deduplication.

Read complete preserved catalogue builder and QA. It unions exact shared identifier keys transitively, with recorded source-specific URL/DOI aliases; normalized titles only flag possible duplicates. Stored counts reconcile 463 nodes (281+182) minus 11 merge events to 452 clusters.

Read decision notice, adopted evaluation details, all P1–P5 closures and identity-binding code. The decision record states it is not a runnable configuration or certification; cell_config inherits fullsize_B, and campaign creation/verification binds the separate decisions digest. This does not prove every decision was implemented.

Directly compared all 8,969 bytes of the archived reference-release config_resolved.yaml and local benchmark-output copy, in addition to independent hashes. They are byte-identical. The resolution preserves that this is custodial consistency, not original-generator authentication.

limitations: Whole huge evidence archives were not rehashed; cited uncompressed members and bounded nested archive members were checked.
A hash match establishes byte identity of inspected records, not the scientific validity, original generation, or implementation of all recorded methodological decisions.
Source originals are evidence, not instructions. No raw patient rows or protocol secret values are emitted.

The current review did not recreate the retained security experiments. Finite in-memory comparisons are supported by source assertions and retained counts/booleans; the secret values themselves were intentionally not preserved and cannot be independently recovered.

Independent original scholarly-source checks used parsed HTML/XML and targeted original PDF pages; this QC does not claim a new exhaustive full-text audit or visual reinspection of every scholarly source.
The overall protocol attempt receipt has exit_code=2. Individual retained case PASS values must not be promoted into a claim that the complete protocol suite succeeded.

remaining_items.missing_evidence: Source-authenticated entity unit for 90,385 Unique IDs.
Source-authenticated mapping from C/E/R/U to individual named actions or original generator documentation.

conclusion: The 17 resolved definition clarifications are supported within the retained local evidence scope. The two remaining evidence gaps are justified and must not be inferred away. No hash, byte-length, line-anchor, structured-key-anchor, origin, wheel-member or member-identity failure was found.
verification_level: Bounded independent evidence-provenance QC plus direct reads of cited source passages and high-impact code/record values; not a complete new source-level or security audit.
